def case(tag, req, expect):  # expect: None for unsat, 'sat' for some valid order, or exact list
    E.append((tag, req, expect))

# zero transactions
case('empty-eq', {'initial': {'a': 0}, 'final': {'a': 0}, 'transactions': []}, [])
case('empty-neq', {'initial': {}, 'final': {'a': 0}, 'transactions': []}, None)
# absent vs zero
case('zero-stored', {'initial': {}, 'final': {'a': 0}, 'transactions': [
    {'id':'t','start':0,'end':1,'ops':[['put','a',0],['get','a',0]]}]}, 'sat')
case('get-zero-on-absent', {'initial': {}, 'final': {}, 'transactions': [
    {'id':'t','start':0,'end':1,'ops':[['get','a',0]]}]}, None)
# cas variants
case('cas-del', {'initial': {'a': 5}, 'final': {}, 'transactions': [
    {'id':'t','start':0,'end':1,'ops':[['cas','a',5,None,True]]}]}, 'sat')
case('cas-absent-null-old', {'initial': {}, 'final': {'a': 3}, 'transactions': [
    {'id':'t','start':0,'end':1,'ops':[['cas','a',None,3,True]]}]}, 'sat')
case('cas-fail-nochange', {'initial': {'a': 1}, 'final': {'a': 1}, 'transactions': [
    {'id':'t','start':0,'end':1,'ops':[['cas','a',2,9,False]]}]}, 'sat')
case('cas-expected-success-mismatch', {'initial': {}, 'final': {'a': 3}, 'transactions': [
    {'id':'t','start':0,'end':1,'ops':[['cas','a',None,3,False]]}]}, None)
# scan: boundaries and lexicographic order, sees own writes
case('scan-own-writes', {'initial': {'b': 1}, 'final': {'a': 2, 'b': 1, 'c': 0}, 'transactions': [
    {'id':'t','start':0,'end':1,'ops':[['put','a',2],['put','c',0],['scan','a','c',[['a',2],['b',1]]],['scan','a','d',[['a',2],['b',1],['c',0]]]]}]}, 'sat')
case('scan-excludes-high', {'initial': {'b': 1}, 'final': {'b': 1}, 'transactions': [
    {'id':'t','start':0,'end':1,'ops':[['scan','a','b',[]]]}]}, 'sat')
case('scan-wrong-order', {'initial': {'b': 1, 'a': 2}, 'final': {'a': 2, 'b': 1}, 'transactions': [
    {'id':'t','start':0,'end':1,'ops':[['scan','a','c',[['b',1],['a',2]]]]}]}, None)
# precedence: touching endpoints force order
case('touching-endpoints', {'initial': {}, 'final': {'a': 2}, 'transactions': [
    {'id':'t0','start':0,'end':5,'ops':[['put','a',1]]},
    {'id':'t1','start':5,'end':9,'ops':[['get','a',1],['put','a',2]]}]}, ['t0','t1'])
case('touching-reversed-unsat', {'initial': {}, 'final': {'a': 2}, 'transactions': [
    {'id':'t0','start':0,'end':5,'ops':[['get','a',1]]},
    {'id':'t1','start':5,'end':9,'ops':[['put','a',1],['put','a',2]]}]}, None)
# negative times and values
case('negative', {'initial': {}, 'final': {'a': -9}, 'transactions': [
    {'id':'t0','start':-10,'end':-3,'ops':[['put','a',-9],['get','a',-9]]}]}, 'sat')
# scan only sees current tx writes, not future
case('scan-isolation', {'initial': {}, 'final': {'a': 1, 'b': 2}, 'transactions': [
    {'id':'t0','start':0,'end':10,'ops':[['put','a',1],['scan','a','z',[['a',1]]]]},
    {'id':'t1','start':1,'end':2,'ops':[['put','b',2]]}]}, None)  # t1 before t0 -> t0's scan would see b
# cyclic reads unsat
case('cycle', {'initial': {}, 'final': {'a':1,'b':1}, 'transactions': [
    {'id':'t0','start':0,'end':10,'ops':[['put','a',1],['get','b',1]]},
    {'id':'t1','start':0,'end':10,'ops':[['put','b',1],['get','a',1]]}]}, None)
# same txs but satisfiable when one reads absent
case('acyclic', {'initial': {}, 'final': {'a':1,'b':1}, 'transactions': [
    {'id':'t0','start':0,'end':10,'ops':[['put','a',1],['get','b',None]]},
    {'id':'t1','start':0,'end':10,'ops':[['put','b',1],['get','a',1]]}]}, 'sat')
# del is idempotent, get null after del
case('del-absent', {'initial': {'a': 1}, 'final': {}, 'transactions': [
    {'id':'t','start':0,'end':1,'ops':[['del','a'],['del','a'],['get','a',None]]}]}, 'sat')
# 10 txs chain where final reachable only via exact order
case('exact-chain-10', {'initial': {}, 'final': {'k': 9}, 'transactions': [
    {'id':f't{i}','start':0,'end':100,'ops':([['get','k',i-1]] if i else [])+[['put','k',i]]} for i in range(10)]}, 'sat')

inp = ''.join(json.dumps(r) + '\n' for _, r, _ in E)
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/app/main.py'], input=inp, text=True, capture_output=True, cwd='/app')
assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr
lines = p.stdout.splitlines()
assert len(lines) == len(E)
bad = 0
for (tag, req, expect), line in zip(E, lines):
    got = json.loads(line)['order']
    if expect is None:
        ok = got is None
    elif expect == 'sat':
        ok = got is not None and valid_history(req, got)
    else:
        ok = got == expect and valid_history(req, got)
    if not ok:
        bad += 1; print('FAIL', tag, 'got', got)
print(f'{len(E)} edge cases, {bad} failed')

import json, random, time, sys, subprocess

worst = 0.0; wreq = None
for it in range(400):
    # mix: each tx 3 puts (distinct values) + 2 dels
    txs = []
    for i in range(10):
        ks = rng.sample(keys, 5)
        ops = [['put', k, rng.randint(-9,9)] for k in ks[:3]] + [['del', k] for k in ks[3:]]
        rng.shuffle(ops)
        txs.append({'id': f't{i}', 'start': 0, 'end': 10, 'ops': ops})
    # achievable-by-construction final, then perturb with values that stay per-key feasible
    order = list(range(10)); rng.shuffle(order)
    d = {}
    for i in order:
        for op in txs[i]['ops']:
            if op[0]=='put': d[op[1]]=op[2]
            else: d.pop(op[1], None)
    if rng.random() < 0.8 and d:
        kk = rng.choice(list(d))
        others = [op[2] for t in txs for op in t['ops'] if op[0]=='put' and op[1]==kk and op[2]!=d[kk]]
        if others: d[kk] = rng.choice(others)
    req = {'initial': {}, 'final': d, 'transactions': txs}
    t0 = time.time(); M.solve(req); dt = time.time()-t0
    if dt > worst: worst, wreq = dt, req
